description: This file defines an Angular component 'NoteEditorComponent' used for editing notes. It manages input/output bindings, reacts to changes in the note data, and interacts with a NotesService to create or update notes.

classes.name: NoteEditorComponent
classes.description: An Angular component for editing notes, supporting both creating new notes and updating existing ones, with input/output bindings and service interactions.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Lifecycle hook that updates the component's title and content fields when the input note changes.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission by creating or updating a note via the NotesService, and emitting the saved note.

ctags.name: content
ctags.pattern: /^    const payload = { title: this.title, content: this.content };$/
